title: Landsat 8/9 surface reflectance (NDVI, bare-soil index)
fetched: 461 overpasses (scene cloud cover < 70 %), pilot-box window of bands blue, red, nir08, swir16, qa_pixel; 4,178 clear field observations
resolution: 30 m; about every 8 days from two satellites, more where two orbit paths overlap
credit: Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 Science Products courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey and NASA. Accessed through Microsoft Planetary Computer.
message: 461 overpasses, 4,178 field observations, median 299 per field; sanity passed
notes: Pixels flagged cloud, cloud shadow, cirrus or water by the Landsat QA band are dropped; an observation is kept only if at least 60 % of the field is clear. Snow-covered observations are kept but flagged, and excluded from greenness statistics. NDVI shows green cover, not soil health, and saturates in dense alfalfa.
